long_biography.plain_text:
Colonna Capital grew from Roberto de Silvestri's early efforts to connect Monaco investors with opportunities in Estonia. After first visiting the country, he began working there as an entrepreneur and investment broker in 2002. Four years later, he founded the commercial-property group. Colonna has since channelled international capital into leasing, investment and development projects across the Baltic market.

De Silvestri combined that platform with a separate philanthropic institution. He founded the Colonna Charity Fund in 2018 to support children's healthcare, building on company campaigns for maternity hospitals and neonatal equipment. His academic training included law at the University of Genoa and asset management at SDA Bocconi. Before Colonna became his defining enterprise, he held banking and private-finance roles in Zurich and Monaco.
